title: My Favorite Comic Strip
text:
Tom likes comic strips. Every morning, he reads them in the newspaper. His favorite comic is about a dog named Max. Max is funny and very smart. Tom laughs every time he reads it.

Today, Tom wants to draw his own comic strip. He has a red pen and five white papers. First, he draws a little cat. Then he writes a funny story about the cat. His friends think his comic is great.

questions.text: What is the name of the dog in Tom's favorite comic?
How many white papers does Tom have?
Why does Tom laugh when he reads his favorite comic?
How does Tom probably feel about his own comic strip?

vocabulary.definition: printed paper with news and stories
makes a picture with a pen or pencil
people you like and spend time with

paragraph_translations: Tom gosta de tirinhas. Todas as manhãs, ele as lê no jornal. A tirinha favorita dele é sobre um cachorro chamado Max. Max é engraçado e muito inteligente. Tom ri toda vez que a lê.

Hoje, Tom quer desenhar sua própria tirinha. Ele tem uma caneta vermelha e cinco folhas brancas. Primeiro, ele desenha um gatinho. Depois, ele escreve uma história engraçada sobre o gato. Seus amigos acham que a tirinha dele é ótima.
